trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of all six sections. Recomputed every numeric with mpmath at 40 dps. CORRECT: E_0 = m_e/(q(q-1)) = 4.185981 MeV at the proton pin (block: approx 4.186); the algebra c_q^2 hbar_q = 1/((q-1)q) with c_q = 1/(q-1) and hbar_q = (q-1)/q = 1 - 1/q; the amplification (1-2q)/(q-1) = -11.09268, which I independently re-derived as d ln E_0 / d ln q = -1 - q/(q-1) and confirmed the two forms are algebraically identical; sqrt(0.3^2 + (11.09*1.22)^2) = 13.533 ppb; sigma_E0 = 5.66e-8 MeV; hbar_q^2/(1-hbar_q^2) = 0.9915% (block: approx 1%); and (4.186-4.155)/4.155 = 0.7461% (block: 0.74%). PIN NOTE: at the printed 4-digit precision E_0 CANNOT discriminate the pins - proton 1.1099785827513808 and muon 1.10997859555733471 both give 4.185981 - so this block's value is pin-agnostic. The erroneous rounding 1.1097 would give 4.197665, so it is demonstrably not in use here.

trap-nonspeakable.notes: MATH AND DOCTRINE FINDINGS (report, not fixed), four items. (1) THE SAME FORMULA IS QUOTED TWICE WITH TWO DIFFERENT VALUES, AND NEITHER MATCHES THE PRINTED INPUTS. The Calibration-cross-check section gives E_0^(cal) = Q_beta / |Delta net| approx 4.155 MeV; the Calibration-by-free-neutron-decay section gives the same quotient as approx 4.179 MeV. The block's own inputs, Q_beta = 0.782 MeV and |Delta net| approx 0.188, give 0.782/0.188 = 4.1596. Back-solving: 4.155 needs |Delta net| = 0.188207, 4.179 needs 0.187126. The 0.74% gap the block computes uses 4.155; had it used 4.179 the gap would be 0.17%, so the choice is load-bearing. (2) A RESIDUAL BETWEEN A QUANTITY AND ITSELF. The boxed derived form DEFINES E_0 = m_e c_q^2 hbar_q, yet the final sentence says 'The 1% residual between E_0 and m_e c_q^2 hbar_q represents the brane tower contribution.' Under the block's own definition that residual is identically zero; the sentence must mean the residual between the CALIBRATED E_0 and the derived one, and should say so. (3) THE CALIBRATION TABLE VIOLATES A STRICT AGENTS.md RULING. It assigns H^0 / H^1 / H^2 degrees to m_e, m_mu/m_e and Q_beta. AGENTS.md states the three calibrations are the three real DOF of the SINGLE H^1(Bring) = 2W - rank-2 W-plane scale plus modulus plus one orthogonal class - and 'NOT three distinct degrees H^0/H^1/H^2'. The H^k column should be removed or relabelled as the three DOF of H^1. (4) Q_beta IS MISLABELLED CAL-3. The block says 'A historical calibrated E_0 definition used CAL-3 (Q_beta) as input'. Per the owner ruling of 2026-06-26, CAL-3 is the pion decay width D_pi (proxy m_pi); Q_beta = hbar/D_beta is the proxy for CAL-2. The opening sentence's 'CAL-2 (q_0)' is also loose - CAL-2 is D_beta, which FIXES q_0. VERIFIED-CORRECT, so a later pass need not re-flag: E_0 = 4.185981, the -11.09 amplification, 13.5 ppb, 5.7e-8 MeV, the 0.9915% structural bound and the 0.74% gap all reproduce exactly.
